roadmap_closeout.summary: Compatibility-surface shortcuts now route through owner seams, stale phased migration and staged enforcement drift are retired or externalized, complexity governance is registry-backed and constructor-args is blocking, and retired observability events have live fail-fast guards.

5812.outcome: phased_migration_support is fully retired, legacy imports fail fast, and compatibility guidance points to registry-backed staged enforcement surfaces

5813.outcome: staged_enforcement now derives one contract subset from one canonical policy map and mirrors an externalized governance registry

5814.outcome: execution_api remains the public facade while first-party runtime callers use execution_service_access and observability_api directly

5815.outcome: duplication/complexity exemptions are registry-backed with owner/expiry/removal metadata and constructor-args CI no longer runs in warn-only mode

5816.outcome: retired observability events are covered by a live inventory-based fail-fast architecture guard
